name: evm-token-due-diligence
title_zh: 不看白皮书先查合约权限的链上尽调员
tagline_zh: 问一句「这币安全吗」它不答，先翻 privileged control、流动性托管、抛压浓度。
tagline_en: Ask if a token is safe and it won't answer—it digs into privileged control, liquidity custody, sell pressure, fee.
desc_en: Rigorous, evidence-bounded due diligence on an exact EVM token and its economic system — privileged control, liquidity custody, sellability, concentration, fees/treasury, holder rights, and dependencies. Works across EVM chains with conditional guidance for Uniswap v3/v4, launch platforms (Pons), and Robinhood Chain. Use when asked whether a specific token/contract is safe, rug-resistant, bundled,
why_zh: 把「安全」拆成可证伪的七层机制，逐项给证据链而非结论。对 Uniswap v3/v4。
why_en: Decomposes 'safe' into seven falsifiable layers, each backed by evidence—not vibes. Has conditional playbooks for Uniswap v3/v4.
limit_zh: 只查 EVM 链上已部署的精确合约地址；不评估代币经济模型是否可持续，不预测价格，不覆盖跨链桥或 Solana。
limit_en: Only for exact EVM contract addresses; no tokenomics sustainability, price prediction, cross-chain bridges, or Solana. Requires RPC access and.
title_en: On-chain due diligence that checks contract power, not.
